I once believed Moiraine would settle down for a while before going to something "radical". But then I thought: Moiraine was absent for a long time, she will not rest. She's not the kind of Aes Sedai to settle, she's not a Brown. At the moment there is only one cause in need of attention, the Seanchan and possibly the Sharans. On the other hand, she has just bonded Thom, maybe they ought to spend some time together, but I would say one month. Or maybe they are going search for possible candidates to the Novice Book in the Westlands.
